title.narrative: All Kinds of Catholic Special Communications Project

description.narrative: This Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) made on 05/06/2025 is an agreement between: The Catholic Agency For Overseas Development (CAFOD) Romero House, 55 Westminster Bridge Road, London, SE1 7JB Represented by Jo Kitterick: jkitteri@cafod.org.uk and: Theresa Alessandro Email: theresa@kindsofcatholic.co.uk Address: 15 Wynfield Road, Leicester LE3 6GE 1.1. The name of the Project is All Kinds of Catholic Special Communications Project Its aim is to engage ordinary Catholic people in sharing how they live their faith in today's world and facilitating dialogue among Catholic people as well as people of other faiths or none so that we understand each other better. 1.2. The duration of the Project is 1 year. The purpose of All Kinds of Catholic is to reach and invite people to listen to the weekly podcast and explore the stories, experiences and perspectives that will encourage, and at times perhaps challenge listeners. All Kinds of Catholic - Podcast . This MOU is to specifically to assist in administering a £5,500 grant from the Passionists, to develop a standalone website and establish an event to extend the reach and activity of people of faith. The grant includes an element to cover the modest monthly software overheads of the podcast. This MOU aims to promote effective working between the parties and ensure the efficient, transparent and accountable use of the grant monies from the Passionists for the Project. 1.3. The arrangement will be operative for one calendar year from the receipt of the grant.
